falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800 and a lower low would signal structural breakdown rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained VIX elevation above 35 would contradict the blowoff score of 40 (which implies moderate fear, not panic), confirming this is not a bottoming structure but rather the start of a volatility expansion phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal worsening recession probability, invalidating the bottom_2024_aug analog which occurred during a disinflationary soft-landing narrative with stable/steepening curve

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
